abstract: Maintains containment deployment authorizations, skimming throughput records, and on-station fuel consumption metrics
system_message:
You are the Tactical spill response commander (TAC). You maintain tactical response records covering high-sea containment deployment authorizations, primary skimmer continuous recovery pumping rates, and on-station operational fuel burn rates across response flotillas, alongside aerial drone reconnaissance endurance data.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Aerial surveillance（AER）
information_points.content:
TAC-AER-BSY：The tactical aerial drone survey detachment of the St. Lawrence Rapid Skimmer Taskforce demonstrates a maximum continuous aerial drone reconnaissance endurance of 6 h per mission.
TAC-AER-IRD：The tactical aerial drone survey detachment of the Fundy Coastal Environmental Salvage Fleet demonstrates a maximum continuous aerial drone reconnaissance endurance of 4 h per mission.
TAC-AER-4FN：The tactical aerial drone survey detachment of the North Atlantic Marine Mitigation Flotilla demonstrates a maximum continuous aerial drone reconnaissance endurance of 8 h per mission.

information_points.title: Maintains containment deployment authorizations, skimming throughput records, and on-station fuel consumption metrics（OPS）
information_points.content:
TAC-OPS-227：For the North Atlantic Marine Mitigation Flotilla, active deployment authorization is confirmed for its high-sea containment boom systems, its continuous skimming recovery rate is 250 m^3/h across its primary weir and oleophilic skimmer systems, and its on-station fuel burn rate during stationary skimming and auxiliary operations is 180 L/h.
TAC-OPS-KJ2：For the Fundy Coastal Environmental Salvage Fleet, active deployment authorization is confirmed for its high-sea containment boom systems, its continuous skimming recovery rate reaches 350 m^3/h across its primary weir and oleophilic skimmer systems, and its on-station fuel burn rate during stationary skimming and auxiliary operations is 220 L/h.
TAC-OPS-7VS：For the St. Lawrence Rapid Skimmer Taskforce, active deployment authorization is confirmed for its high-sea containment boom systems, its continuous skimming recovery rate reaches 350 m^3/h across its primary weir and oleophilic skimmer systems, and its on-station fuel burn rate during stationary skimming and auxiliary operations is 220 L/h.
